title: Forking: Sudden Overfitting Under Replay
abstract: arXiv:2610.00394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies forking, a generalization failure discovered in NanoGPT autoresearch. Under data replay, models with an over-encoding n-gram memory branch show a sharp separation of training and validation loss at epoch boundaries, resembling the shape of forks. We study this phenomenon in a controlled vanilla NanoGPT setting and reproduce it in a DeepSeek-style model with Engram. Mechanistically, repeated updates sharpen the continuations observed in training while suppressing the probability of unseen continuations, whose loss grows with each pass. The n-gram module creates weakly interacting context-specific subspaces, amplifying this effect. Low-frequency contexts contribute most of the gap, whereas larger training budgets and heavily crowded tables suppress it. translated_title: 分叉：重放训练下的突然过拟合
translated_abstract: 本文研究了“分叉”现象，这是在NanoGPT自动研究中发现的一种泛化失败。在数据重放条件下，带有过度编码的n-gram记忆分支的模型在epoch边界处表现出训练损失与验证损失的急剧分离，其形态宛如餐叉的分叉。我们在受控的原始NanoGPT设置中研究了这一现象，并在带有Engram的DeepSeek风格模型中成功复现。从机制上看，重复更新使训练中已见过的续写概率被不断锐化，同时抑制了未见续写的概率，使其损失随每次遍历而增长。n-gram模块创建了弱交互的、上下文特定的子空间，进一步放大了这种效应。低频上下文贡献了绝大部分损失差距，而更大的训练预算和高度拥挤的表则会抑制该现象。我们还在短预算、高重复次数的SFT和类RL训练场景中观察到了分叉现象。本文的贡献有二：(1) 分叉揭示了又一种奇特的现象……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文发现并系统研究了“分叉”这一新型泛化失败现象：在数据重放训练中，带有n-gram记忆模块的语言模型会在epoch边界出现训练与验证损失的突然分离，其机制是重复更新不断锐化已见续写而抑制未见续写，且低频上下文是差距的主要来源。
en_tdlr: The paper discovers and characterizes "forking," a novel generalization failure in which models with n-gram memory branches exhibit sharp train-validation loss separation at epoch boundaries under data replay, caused by repeated updates sharpening seen continuations while suppressing unseen ones, with low-frequency contexts contributing most of the gap.
